outcome: Maternal drug use (crack cocaine, intravenous drugs)
cohort: Opioid-dependent mother-infant pairs receiving methadone maintenance treatment from an inner-city Specialist NHS Substance Misuse Service.
finding: Infants of mothers receiving <=30mg methadone/day at delivery were nearly twice as likely to be treated for NAS compared to infants of mothers receiving >30mg/day.
birth_weight: Reported, but specific values not provided
